title: Rexville Radiology
description: rexvilleradiology.com Rexville Radiology is a diagnostic imaging center in Bayamón, Puerto Rico, founded by neuro-radiology specialist Dr. Ramón Pizarro Fornaris and accredited by the American College of Radiology. It offers a full range of imaging services under one roof including open MRI, 64-slice CT scanning, 3D digital mammography with tomosynthesis, ultrasound, DEXA bone density and digital X-ray. The center stands out for its open MRI design that accommodates claustrophobic patients and its advanced breast imaging with 3D tomosynthesis for early cancer detection. Led by Dr. Pizarro, a recognized neuro-radiologist, it provides personalized care with fast turnaround times and early opening hours from 6 AM six days a week.
